verdict.rationale: Marqeta offers building blocks that act on their own once set up. Velocity and authorization controls enforce spending rules on every transaction without manual action. Webhooks push event notifications to your endpoint as they occur, and Gateway JIT Funding lets your system approve or deny funding at transaction time using your own business rules. However, any real background automation has to be built and hosted in your own environment, and the MCP server is documented only for agents to query data, not for scheduling autonomous jobs. Missing for 10: a native automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered background jobs run by Marqeta, agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
